ruleWarningPolicy.decision: Only hiker-facing warnings should reach runtime user surfaces.
runtimeEligibleWarnings: legal or local rules that affect hiking behavior
route hazards and known current-condition warnings
camping, fire, dog, cycling, bathing, fishing, water-protection and access restrictions
source contradictions that change how a hiker should plan or navigate
runtimeIneligibleWarnings: debug notes about snapping, reversing, geometry repair or section assignment unless rewritten as hiker-facing caveats
ruleWarningPolicy.granularity: Prefer subsegment or facility/site-level warnings after GIS overlay. Use whole-section warnings only when exact subsegment scope is unknown but the warning is important.
ruleWarningPolicy.currentness: Fire bans, temporary closures, forestry/storm damage, ferry/boat service, transit, business openings, water reliability and cabin/hut season must be rechecked immediately before publication.

records.title: camping
records.summary: Do not treat Skuruhatt visitor facilities as a general free-camping area. In Skurugata nature reserve, tenting is allowed only at designated place and overnighting in vehicle, camper, or rooftop tent is prohibited.

records.title: fire

records.title: dogs

records.title: hazards
records.summary: The Skurugata gorge/top area is rougher than HÖ1's blue rating: rocky/boulder terrain, slippery stone after rain, humidity/cold, and lingering snow/ice possible into spring or early summer. The accessible route from parking to Skuruhatt is easier.

The Åsjön shelter was reported vandalized/littered/graffiti-marked and without firewood at that time.
